cases.query: I've just taken over this repo after a week away. Summarize each active effort's current phase, how its increments and pull requests are progressing, where work has drifted, and the next move.
The workspace loads, but note headers and spec-to-plan links may have been damaged in a merge. Identify the convention violations and show the safe correction set before touching anything.
Several memory notes keep teaching the same deployment lesson. Work out a single durable version, which notes it supersedes, and what supporting docs would need to change.
